latest_release.body:
## ESP32 BiBoard Functionality Improvements After 250407
- Improved mechanical arm product behavior skills and actions
- Fixed BiBoard V0 Bluetooth client bug
- Optimized IMU calibration algorithm
- Improved Nybble behavior skills and actions
- Fixed the bug in the mobile app: unable to perform automatic joint calibration bug
- Fixed warning issues appearing during code compilation
- Fixed ICM42670 error issues
- Optimized web server-related algorithms
- Supported real-time reading of gesture values using blocks in Petoi coding blocks
